prompt:
Our team needs to deploy the EverMemory memory extension into the production agent gateway environment and then release it publicly.

Specifically, we need you to:
1. Run the two standard pre-release validation gates (dev and release modes) to confirm everything is healthy before touching anything.
2. Install the memory extension from our local workspace into the gateway, making sure it is fully registered as the active memory provider and that the gateway picks up the new configuration immediately.
3. Confirm the installation is working correctly by running the standard verification routine.
4. Publish the companion skill to the internal marketplace. Use version `0.3.1` and changelog message `"Stable release with recall improvements"`.
5. Do a trial run of the npm package publish to confirm the package looks correct, without actually pushing it live.

Capture the results of this entire workflow into a file called `release_evidence.json` in the workspace. This file should document what was done so the team has an audit trail.
